g.text: How soon retained storage is issued again
Successful object issues in the same allocator instance after retirement
CDF at logarithmic bin upper bounds, three runs per curve. Cross-instance reuse is excluded. A gap of 1 means the next issue.
Wireshark: one curve per input, color and line style denote allocator. Coverage and raw denominators are in summary.csv.
